metadata.description: Name of the Standard Logic App resource.
Name of the WorkflowStandard App Service Plan.
Storage account name — alphanumeric, 3-24 chars. A uniqueString suffix is appended by default to avoid collisions.

Log Analytics workspace ID (GUID) of the Sentinel workspace — Log Analytics workspace → Overview → Workspace ID. Used by GIBTIA_IndicatorProcessor_v2's Upload_Indicators_V2 path; an empty value fails at runtime with 404.
Log Analytics workspace name (used for query URI construction).
YYYY-MM-DD. First-run cursor used by every collector to convert into an initial seqUpdate. Ignored after first run.
Page size for GIB collector API calls. Use 10 for initial testing; raise to 1000-5000 for production. Per-collection maxima documented in USER_GUIDE_STANDARD.md §7.
IOC Primary filter: all, network (IP/domain/URL only), or file (hashes only).
When true, IOC Primary uses each entry's GIB riskScore as the STIX confidence.
Fixed confidence value 0-100 for IOC Primary indicators. -1 omits the field. Ignored when UseRiskScoreAsConfidence is true.

When true, IOC Primary derives STIX confidence by parsing evaluation.admiraltyCode (e.g. "C3") via the Admiralty Code lookup tables and emitting (reliability + credibility) / 2. Highest precedence — falls through to UseRiskScoreAsConfidence / FixedConfidence when admiraltyCode is missing or malformed on a record.

compromised/breacheddb only. 1 = only ingest breach records that carry a leaked password (default, matches the password-notification use case). 0 = collect all breach records regardless of password presence.

compromised/account_group only. Feed type: 'unique' (default) = only unique credentials (unique=1&combolist=0); 'combolist' = only combo-list credentials (unique=0&combolist=1); 'all' = every credential (no unique/combolist filter).
compromised/account_group only. 1 = return only probable corporate-access credentials (&probable_corporate_access=1). 0 = no corporate-access filter (default). Independent of AccountFeedType.

Name of the Data Collection Rule this template creates for all 26 collectors (letters, digits and hyphens only, 3-30 characters). The workflows read its ingestion endpoint and immutable ID from the DcrEndpoint / DcrImmutableId app settings, which this template fills in.

Leave as is unless your Log Analytics workspace is in a different Azure region from this resource group. The Data Collection Rule must be created in the workspace's region; the default is this resource group's region.

true (default): the template grants the Logic App's managed identity Monitoring Metrics Publisher on the Data Collection Rule, so collectors can write as soon as they run. Requires the deploying account to hold Owner or User Access Administrator on the resource group. Set false if it does not, and assign that role by hand (post-deploy.sh does it too). Microsoft Sentinel Contributor on the workspace is still assigned by post-deploy.sh or by hand.

properties.description: Group-IB TI (Standard package): Logs Ingestion destination for the seqUpdate cursor and the 14 context tables of all collectors in one Logic App. kind=Direct; api-version 2023-03-11 is deliberate (see DEV_NOTES).
